summary: Hafnia Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 3, 2026, announcing an ex-dividend of USD 0.2877 per share on the Oslo Stock Exchange and the New York Stock Exchange. The dividend relates to Q1 2026, previously announced on May 27, 2026. This is a routine dividend declaration and not a special situation event. The filing includes a press release and is in compliance with the Norwegian Securities Trading Act. No special-situation features are present, such as a tender offer, restructuring, or acquisition. The role of the registrant is issuer, but the event is ordinary-course. Therefore, this does not qualify as a special situation under the given categories.
